channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andrew Nembhard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andrew Nembhard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell, Andrew Nembhard, Bennedict Mathurin
item.description:
Tony East:Rick Carlisle on defense in the final minutes:

“McConnell, Nembhard, Mathurin, these guys did a great job defensively tonight. Mathurin's defense has taken a real step forward this year. He's taken matchups, he did a really great job on Giddey... this is part of the growth process.”

Rick Carlisle on TJ McConnell, Andrew Nembhard, Bennedict Mathurin, Nov 29, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Todd Ramasar on Andrew Nembhard, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Todd Ramasar:

“Even though the season started off slowly, it was a natural progression for him where he got better every month. The whole world got to really see Andrew on display in the playoffs with Tyrese there. Once Tyrese went down with injuries, you saw Andrew be in his natural position as the primary ball handler. You saw him step up and play huge for his team. Unfortunately, the team fell short. Andrew, like a lot of young players, learned from the experience with being in the playoffs. But the team has always valued Andrew as being one of their own and has always seen him as an integral part. That’s what led to the extension being done now.”

Todd Ramasar on Andrew Nembhard, Tyrese Haliburton, Jul 29, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Todd Ramasar on Andrew Nembhard
item.description:
Todd Ramasar:

“I think it’s good for both sides. I think in a year or two that people are going to say it’s a bargain for the Pacers and maybe even after next season. But it’s security for Andrew, which you don’t always see for a second-round pick. The fourth year of his contract falls off, which was $2 million and now he’s earning close to $20 million. That sets him up for the future. It takes pressure off him so he can focus purely on his game and help contribute to winning basketball with the Pacers.”

Todd Ramasar on Andrew Nembhard, Jul 29, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Oshae Brissett on Andrew Nembhard
item.description:
“I feel like it's kind of the same thing. Everyone stepped up and obviously [Andrew Nembhard] had a big game, but everyone was able to step in and do their part.”

Oshae Brissett on Andrew Nembhard, Dec 6, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Andrew Nembhard
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Andrew Nembhard:

“I’ve been saying when @hoopshype does their redraft of the 2022 class, he’ll be a Top 15 pick. I’m elevating that to Top 10.He really is a special player.”

Rick Carlisle on Andrew Nembhard, Dec 6, 2022. Source: Twitter.
